verification_results.a_blockrazor_floor_and_conflict: CONFIRMED. The value is 0.05 gwei = 50000000 wei in all 4 sources. Two rules still exist side by side. (1) send-bundle.md: each transaction in the bundle must pay at least the BSC validator minimum, 'Currently at 0.05 gwei'. (2) The README FAQ and blockrazor.io/support/ (same text): the average gas price over the non-mempool transactions must be at least 0.05 gwei, with any builder tip added to the numerator and only non-mempool gasUsed in the denominator. The RPC page (eth_sendbundle.md) allows 0-gwei transactions, but the non-public-mempool average must be at least 0.05 gwei.
verification_results.b_48club_absence_of_explicit_floor: REFUTED at site level, so the fetcher's CHANGED is CONFIRMED. web3.48.club/docs/mev-builder/auction-transaction-feed, in its backrunTarget section, requires a bundle's average gas price to meet 'the 0.05 gwei requirement'. Public-pool transactions are excluded. The feed field extra_gas_fee is defined against the same 0.05 gwei requirement. The two pages the addendum cited (/builder including its JS chunk, and /bundle-status) still contain no gwei figure, which is CONFIRMED. The legacy GitBook copy, docs.48.club auction-transaction-feed.md, still says 1 gwei (lines 27, 44, 50). This page is stale. Whether the web3 text already existed on 2026-10-11 cannot be determined, because no history is published.
verification_results.c_maxBlockNumber_type: CONFIRMED: both builders expect an integer. 48Club GitBook lists uint64 and its JSON example is the bare integer 39177941. The 48Club web3 type is `number`, with no hex form documented. BlockRazor lists uint64, its example is the bare integer 39177941, and it rejects with -38000 when the value is smaller than the current block. The live code sends a JSON integer: engine/crates/execution/src/bin/g07_mainnet_self_launch_buy/main.rs:347 `let max_block = send_head.checked_add(2)` is a u64 passed through serde_json at lines 358 and 370; frame.rs:326 uses put_u64. NEW CAVEAT: the 48Club web3 maxBlockNumber row also says 'Provide at least one valid expiry condition with `maxTimestamp`'. All official 48Club /builder code examples send only maxTimestamp (now+20s). Our 48Club body sends maxBlockNumber without maxTimestamp. GitBook documents maxBlockNumber alone, defaulting to current+100. Whether a maxBlockNumber-only bundle is accepted is ambiguous and cannot be resolved read-only.
verification_results.d_gas_price_and_interval: CONFIRMED. One eth_gasPrice call at 2026-10-16T01:38:19.652Z returned 0x2faf080 = 50000000 wei. Block interval is 450 ms nominal (details under chain).
verification_results.e_github_blob_comparison: CONFIRMED. The verifier fetched the files independently at HEAD 31f8f0b97de23a6df401dc70ae493b76f9b70c19 and at the pinned a0dc79d6901c50ebeb45887d829bf34527261adb, then ran git hash-object. send-bundle.md = db80a34f3e3a01ddb9b141c6cbee7a5b83efe90e, README.md = d7a847f74deae5738f20dc35d12a6febd9092918 and rpc/bsc/eth_sendbundle.md = 1e54a4433f4b0c90cb7e337bf3f1c350b7308ca0. The compare API reports status=ahead, ahead_by=6, behind_by=0, 19 files changed, and none of them is under transaction-submission/block-builder/, transaction-submission/rpc/bsc/ or get-started/authentication.md. fortyeightclub.endpoint_host: puissant-builder.48.club (HTTPS https://puissant-builder.48.club/; WSS wss://puissant-builder.48.club/ with conditional access as a 48SP benefit). The live code constant CLUB48_HOST matches.
fortyeightclub.maxBlockNumber_type: integer (GitBook uint64; web3 `number`; no hex documented). It is inclusive ('up to and including' on web3). The GitBook default is current+100; web3 states no default. No maximum window is documented anywhere.
fortyeightclub.auth_note: No API key or auth header is documented. The official examples send only Content-Type. 48spSign is optional and raises limits.
fortyeightclub.explicit_floor_scope: Stated only on the web3 auction-transaction-feed page, in the backrunTarget context, as a requirement on the bundle average over non-public-pool transactions. The legacy GitBook copy says 1 gwei (stale). The pages the addendum cited state no number.
fortyeightclub.floor_rule: The bundle's average gas price over non-public-pool transactions must meet 0.05 gwei. A backrun target priced below 0.05 counts as non-public and is included in the average; a target above 0.05 is excluded. The GitBook FAQ says the average is checked, not one representative transaction, so 0-gas transactions are possible if the other transactions pay enough. A conflicting note on the web3 sendBundle page says gas price is checked on the first transaction (the sender). With every transaction at exactly 50000000, both readings are satisfied, at equality.
fortyeightclub.ranking_rule: auctionPrice = 0.9 x sum of gas fees of the bundle transactions not in the public pool + BNB sent to the Builder Control EOA 0x4848489f0b2BEdd788c696e2D79b6b69D7484848 (the 10% discount reflects the BEP95 burn). The bundle-status priority is the included transactions' gas fees after adjustments plus direct transfers.

chain.block_interval_evidence: Verifier headers: head 127891838 at 2026-10-16T01:38:19.650Z and head-200 127891638 at 01:36:49.650Z, so 90000 ms / 200 = 450.000. All 19 gaps in 20 consecutive full blocks were exactly 450 ms. The long run from 127008491 (2026-10-11T11:04:09.500Z) to 127891838 averages 450.616 ms. Timestamps are milliTimestamp = timestamp*1000 + last 2 bytes of mixHash (BEP-520), and the identity holds on all checked headers. The fetcher's observation that block 127008491 is at 11:04:09.500Z, not the given 11:04:07Z, is CONFIRMED. The head was 193 ms old when the verifier read it.

reasons: Every refreshable explicit floor is 50000000 wei: BlockRazor per transaction, BlockRazor average with tip in the numerator, BlockRazor RPC average, the 48Club web3 average, and the BNB Chain standard gas price. Every one of these rules allows equality ('at least', 'not less than', 'meet').

The live G0.7 binary signs legacy transactions (sign_legacy) with one gas_price and direct_builder_tip_wei = 0. Each transaction's effective price is therefore exactly 50000000, which satisfies both the per-transaction and the average rules and both 48Club readings (average vs first transaction).
maxBlockNumber is serialized as a JSON integer, which matches the documented uint64/number type at both builders.
The public eth_gasPrice is still 50000000 and baseFee is 0.
caveats: There is zero margin: the candidate sits exactly on the boundary for every rule.

The addendum's 48Club fields are stale. explicit_minimum_documented should become true, with 50000000 wei scoped to the web3 auction-feed (backrun) context. The legacy GitBook page says 1 gwei but is outdated.
The addendum's BlockRazor rule text omits the tip-in-numerator detail and the per-transaction statement.
48Club maxTimestamp wording ambiguity (not a fee issue).
0.05 gwei with tip 0 is the lowest-priority tier under both ranking rules, so inclusion within the roughly 900 ms window is not established. This matches the addendum's non_claims.

review_corrections_2026-10-16: The 'YES (conditional)' verdict answers only: do the signed 0.05 gwei / tip 0 parameters meet every refreshable documented fee floor. It does not claim builder acceptance, inclusion or competitiveness.

The head+2 analysis assumes the head is read immediately before release. The current G0.7 code computes maxBlockNumber from a head read at the start of its preflight (main.rs:185/347; preflight 2nd RPC), several seconds before release; at 450 ms blocks the bundle would very likely be expired on arrival. Open code decision, see bsc/docs/G07_ATTEMPT1_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW.md.

48Club: the 0.05 gwei text was observed on 2026-10-16; whether it existed on 2026-10-11 is unknown; it is stated in the backrun (auction-transaction-feed) context and its applicability to non-backrun bundles is unverified. The legacy GitBook 1 gwei statement appears outdated (inference).
Compliance: activity before the usage-limit interruption was only partly logged; no builder host appears in any recorded log.
Raw fetched bodies were kept only in volatile local scratch; only their SHA-256 values are recorded here.
The frame.rs:326 citation refers to the production framing code, not to the G0.7 path (main.rs:358/370 serialize maxBlockNumber as a JSON integer).
